books.author: Nicola Rijsdijk
books.description_zh: 从肯尼亚的菜园到种树行动，认识旺加里·马塔伊的求学与环保故事。适合 5–6 岁成人陪读，讨论树木、家乡和集体行动；含贫困与人物离世情节。

pages.image_alt: 幼年旺加里和妈妈站在肯尼亚山脚的菜地里，背景有山峰。
pages.text_zh: 在东非肯尼亚山坡上的一个村庄里，一个小女孩和妈妈一起在田里劳动。她的名字叫旺加里。
pages.text_original: In a village on the slopes of Mount Kenya in East Africa, a little girl worked in the fields with her mother. Her name was Wangari.

pages.image_alt: 旺加里在菜畦中播种，松土用的砍刀平放在一旁。
pages.text_zh: 旺加里喜欢待在户外。她在家里的菜园里用砍刀松开泥土，把小小的种子按进温暖的土地。
pages.text_original: Wangari loved being outside. In her family’s food garden she broke up the soil with her machete. She pressed tiny seeds into the warm earth.

pages.image_alt: 落日下，旺加里提着蔬菜沿田间小路走过河上的小桥。
pages.text_zh: 她最喜欢一天里太阳刚刚落山的时候。当天色暗得看不清植物了，旺加里就知道该回家了。她沿着田间窄窄的小路走，途中还要穿过河流。
pages.text_original: Her favourite time of day was just after sunset. When it got too dark to see the plants, Wangari knew it was time to go home. She would follow the narrow paths through the fields, crossing rivers as she went.

pages.image_alt: 七岁的旺加里背着书包，哥哥陪她走向学校，一位家人在后方送行。
pages.text_zh: 旺加里是个聪明的孩子，特别盼望去上学。可是爸爸妈妈想让她留在家里帮忙。七岁那年，哥哥说服了父母，让她去学校读书。
pages.text_original: Wangari was a clever child and couldn’t wait to go to school. But her mother and father wanted her to stay and help them at home. When she was seven years old, her big brother persuaded her parents to let her go to school.

pages.image_alt: 旺加里在书桌前读书，打开的书上画着世界地图，窗外一架飞机飞过。
pages.text_zh: 她喜欢学习！每读一本书，旺加里就懂得更多。她的成绩非常好，后来得到了去美国留学的机会。旺加里很兴奋，她想更多地了解世界。
pages.text_original: She liked to learn! Wangari learnt more and more with every book she read. She did so well at school that she was invited to study in the United States of America. Wangari was excited! She wanted to know more about the world.

pages.image_alt: 长大后的旺加里在大学实验桌旁用放大镜观察幼苗，回忆气泡里是童年树下的游戏。
pages.text_zh: 在美国的大学里，旺加里学到了许多新知识。她研究植物怎样生长，也想起了自己的成长：小时候，她和兄弟们在美丽的肯尼亚森林里，在树荫下玩游戏。
pages.text_original: At the American university Wangari learnt many new things. She studied plants and how they grow. And she remembered how she grew: playing games with her brothers in the shade of the trees in the beautiful Kenyan forests.

pages.image_alt: 旺加里坐在书堆旁阅读，窗边的想象画面里是肯尼亚家乡。
pages.text_zh: 懂得越多，旺加里就越明白自己多么爱肯尼亚的人民。她希望大家幸福、自由。懂得越多，她就越想念非洲的家。
pages.text_original: The more she learnt, the more she realised that she loved the people of Kenya. She wanted them to be happy and free. The more she learnt, the more she remembered her African home.

pages.image_alt: 旺加里回到家乡，看见树桩、大片农田和提着空柴篮的妇女。
pages.text_zh: 学业结束后，她回到了肯尼亚。可是家乡变了，大片农场铺满大地。妇女们没有做饭用的柴火，人们生活贫困，孩子们忍着饥饿。
pages.text_original: When she had finished her studies, she returned to Kenya. But her country had changed. Huge farms stretched across the land. Women had no wood to make cooking fires. The people were poor and the children were hungry.

pages.image_alt: 旺加里教三位妇女播种和移栽幼苗，旁边摆着待出售的苗盆。
pages.text_zh: 旺加里知道该怎么做。她教妇女们从种子开始种树。大家卖掉树苗，用挣来的钱照顾家人。妇女们很高兴，旺加里让她们感到自己有力量，也有办法。
pages.text_original: Wangari knew what to do. She taught the women how to plant trees from seeds. The women sold the trees and used the money to look after their families. The women were very happy. Wangari had helped them to feel powerful and strong.

pages.image_alt: 近处是幼苗，远处是重新长起的树林，一条河穿过绿色土地。
pages.text_zh: 时间慢慢过去，新种的树长成了森林，河流又开始流淌。旺加里的倡议传遍非洲。如今，从她倡导种下的种子里，已经长出了数以百万计的树。
pages.text_original: As time passed, the new trees grew into forests, and the rivers started flowing again. Wangari’s message spread across Africa. Today, millions of trees have grown from Wangari’s seeds.

pages.image_alt: 旺加里佩戴绿色头巾，手捧象征和平奖的金色奖章，身后是树木。
pages.text_zh: 旺加里辛勤的努力被世界各地的人们看见了。她获得了一项著名的奖项，叫作诺贝尔和平奖。她是第一位获得这个奖项的非洲女性。
pages.text_original: Wangari had worked hard. People all over the world took notice, and gave her a famous prize. It is called the Nobel Peace Prize, and she was the first African woman ever to receive it.

pages.image_alt: 一棵高大的树在阳光下伸展枝叶，孩子和家长在树荫下照料幼苗。
pages.text_zh: 旺加里在二〇一一年去世了。但每当看见一棵美丽的树，我们都可以想起她。
pages.text_original: Wangari died in 2011, but we can think of her every time we see a beautiful tree.

books.author: Nozizwe Herero
books.description_zh: 小鸡黛西想飞，嘲笑和失败让她难过，妈妈的支持陪她继续尝试。适合讨论愿望、挫折与鼓励。

pages.image_alt: 黄色小鸡黛西站在小农场的鸡舍前，远处是村庄。
pages.text_zh: 从前，在一个小村庄附近的小农场里，住着一只名叫黛西的小鸡。
pages.text_original: Once upon a time on a little farm near a little village there lived a little chicken called Daisy.

pages.image_alt: 黛西张开小翅膀指向天空，三只小鸡在一旁笑。
pages.text_zh: “等我长大了，我要飞得高高的，飞上天空！”黛西说。可是，其他小鸡都笑了起来。
pages.text_original: “When I grow up, I want to fly high, high into the sky,” Daisy said. But all the other chickens laughed at her.

pages.image_alt: 鸡妈妈用翅膀搂着黛西，其他小鸡站在远处。
pages.text_zh: “你真奇怪。”它们说，“我们再也不跟你玩了。”妈妈告诉她：“黛西，我们都会扑扇翅膀，可是鸡要飞起来很不容易。”
pages.text_original: “You are so weird,” they said. “We won’t play with you anymore.” “Daisy, we can all flap our wings but it’s very difficult for chickens to fly,” Mama told her.

pages.image_alt: 黛西独自在鸡舍旁扑扇翅膀，两只脚仍在地面。
pages.text_zh: 黛西不肯放弃。每天，她都独自练习扑扇翅膀。扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！可她还是飞不离地面。
pages.text_original: Daisy wouldn’t give up. Every day she practised by herself, flapping her wings. Flap, flap, flap, she would flap her wings but she couldn’t lift off the ground.

pages.image_alt: 云朵形想象画面中，黛西飞过麻雀和燕子，农场在下面。
pages.text_zh: 练习的时候，她想象自己飞上高空，低头看着地面上的小鸡。她想象自己飞过麻雀，飞过燕子。“哇！”鸟儿们会说，“一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.text_original: While she practised, she imagined herself flying high into the sky and looking at the chickens below. She imagined herself flying past the sparrows and past the swallows. “Wow!” the birds would say. “A chicken that can fly!”

pages.image_alt: 黛西从低处跳起又落向软草，翅膀用力扑扇。
pages.text_zh: 于是，扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！黛西每天都练习。她离开了地面，却又跌落下来。
pages.text_original: So ... Flap, flap, flap, every day Daisy would flap her wings. She would lift off the ground but fall down again.

pages.image_alt: 黛西眼含泪水靠在鸡妈妈身边，妈妈俯身安慰她。
pages.text_zh: “我永远也飞不起来！”黛西哭着对妈妈说，“它们说得对。”妈妈说：“黛西，你和其他小鸡不一样。它们不想飞，可是你想！你能做到。”
pages.text_original: “I’m never going to fly!” Daisy cried to Mama. “The others are right.” “Daisy, you are different from the other chickens. They don’t want to fly but you do! You can do it,” Mama said.

pages.image_alt: 黛西从矮鸡舍屋顶扑向空中，身后留下起飞的轨迹。
pages.text_zh: 第二天，黛西爬上鸡舍顶。扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！她飞到了半空中，不停地扑扇翅膀，扑扇呀，扑扇呀，然后……
pages.text_original: The following day Daisy climbed to the top of the chicken coop and flap, flap, flap, she flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings and ...

pages.image_alt: 黛西落在松软草堆里，三只小鸡在一旁笑。
pages.text_zh: 砰！黛西又落到了地上。其他小鸡哈哈大笑：“我们早就说过，鸡不会飞！”
pages.text_original: BAM! The other chickens laughed out loud.“Ha ha ha! We told you! Chickens can’t fly!”

pages.image_alt: 黛西从更高的圆屋草顶起飞，风托着她的翅膀。
pages.text_zh: 可是，再过一天，黛西爬得更高，一直爬到了圆屋的屋顶上。扑扇，扑扇，扑扇！她飞到了半空中，不停地扑扇翅膀，扑扇呀，扑扇呀，然后……
pages.text_original: But the next day Daisy climbed even higher, right up to the top of the rondavel. Flap, flap, flap, Daisy flapped her wings. She flew into the air and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings ... and flapped her wings and ...

pages.image_alt: 黛西展开翅膀在云间飞翔，麻雀和燕子陪在两侧。
pages.text_zh: 她真的一直在飞！翅膀下面的风越来越有力，她越飞越高。麻雀和燕子说：“太神奇了！一只会飞的鸡！”
pages.text_original: She kept flying! The wind beneath her wings grew stronger and she flew higher and higher! The sparrows and the swallows said, “Amazing! A flying chicken!”

pages.image_alt: 小鸡们站在鸡舍顶张开翅膀，抬头望着空中的黛西。
pages.text_zh: 其他小鸡也想像她一样。它们说：“哦，黛西，你真了不起！”
pages.text_original: And the other chickens wanted to be just like her. They said, “Oh Daisy, you’re amazing!”

books.author: Julia Smuts Louw
books.description_zh: 好朋友没来上学，津齐该和谁玩呢？从一起做康复卡片开始，她发现：交新朋友，也能珍惜老朋友。

pages.image_alt: 两只大眼睛的小动物依偎着，一起读一本蓝色的书。
pages.text_zh: 津齐和提姆是最好的朋友。他们做什么都在一起。
pages.text_original: Zindzi and Tim Tam were best friends. They did everything together.

pages.image_alt: 戴着蓝色高帽的奥斯温发出邀请，津齐和提姆仍然坐在一起。
pages.text_zh: “你想一起玩装扮游戏吗？”奥斯温问。“不用啦，谢谢。”津齐说，“我要和提姆一起玩。”
pages.text_original: “Do you want to play dress-up?” asked Oswin. “No thank you,” said Zindzi. “I’ll play dress-up with Tim Tam.”

pages.image_alt: 戴着纸角的卡娅邀请津齐拼图，津齐想着自己的朋友提姆。
pages.text_zh: “你想和我一起拼拼图吗？”卡娅问。“不用啦，谢谢。”津齐说，“我喜欢和提姆一起拼。”
pages.text_original: “Do you want to do a puzzle with me?” asked Kaya. “No thank you,” said Zindzi. “I like doing puzzles with Tim Tam.”

pages.image_alt: 两只穿山甲踩着滑板车，津齐站在旁边。
pages.text_zh: “你想参加我们的滑板车比赛吗？”双胞胎问。“不用啦，谢谢。”津齐说，“我要和提姆一起比赛。”
pages.text_original: “Do you want to join our scooter race?” asked The Twins. “No thank you,” said Zindzi. “I’ll race with Tim Tam.”

pages.image_alt: 津齐独自站在穿着橙色拖鞋的刺猬老师旁边。
pages.text_zh: 有一天，提姆没来上学。“提姆生病了。”老师说，“津齐，和其他朋友一起玩，好吗？”
pages.text_original: One day, Tim Tam didn’t come to school. “Tim Tam is sick,” said Teacher. “Why don’t you play with your other friends, Zindzi?”

pages.image_alt: 奥斯温在放着彩笔和纸张的桌旁做卡片，津齐在一边看着。
pages.text_zh: 奥斯温正在给提姆做一张“早日康复”卡。“可是……提姆是我最好的朋友。”津齐说。
pages.text_original: Oswin was making a Get Well Soon card for Tim Tam. “But... Tim Tam is my best friend,” said Zindzi.

pages.image_alt: 奥斯温和津齐拿着画笔，一起在大纸上画出彩色图案。
pages.text_zh: “你可以来帮我呀。”奥斯温说，“蘸一蘸，点一点。”“蘸一蘸，点一点。”津齐也跟着说。
pages.text_original: “You can help me,” said Oswin. “Dip dip, dab dab.” “Dip dip, dab dab,” said Zindzi.

pages.image_alt: 几个朋友先玩装扮和跳房子，再一起骑着滑板车前进。
pages.text_zh: 卡片做好后，奥斯温和津齐玩起了装扮游戏。第二天，他们和卡娅一起跳房子。又过了一天，他们三个还和双胞胎一起骑滑板车。
pages.text_original: When the card was done, Oswin and Zindzi played dress-up. The next day, they played hopscotch with Kaya. The day after that, the three of them rode scooters with The Twins.

pages.image_alt: 津齐和回到学校的提姆站在一起，奥斯温捧着一本书。
pages.text_zh: 星期一，提姆回学校了。“我们去和奥斯温一起看书吧！”津齐说。
pages.text_original: On Monday, Tim Tam came back to school. “Let’s go read a book with Oswin!” said Zindzi.

pages.image_alt: 提姆和津齐面对面说话，奥斯温举着画有红心的卡片。
pages.text_zh: “奥斯温现在是你最好的朋友了吗？”提姆问。“他是我的新朋友。”津齐说，“他也是你的朋友呀！瞧，我们给你做了张卡片。”
pages.text_original: “Is Oswin your best friend now?” asked Tim Tam. “He’s my new friend,” said Zindzi. “He’s your friend too! Look, we made you a card.”

pages.image_alt: 三个朋友一起看着画有红心和彩色手印的大卡片。
pages.text_zh: “我们大家一起玩，好吗？”
pages.text_original: “Should we all play together?”

pages.image_alt: 小动物们聚在一起，敲鼓、跳舞，彩纸在空中飞舞。
pages.text_zh: “好呀！”提姆说，“让我们都做好朋友吧！”
pages.text_original: “Okay,” said Tim Tam. “Let’s all be best friends!”

books.author: Edna Gicovi
books.description_zh: 博拉害怕打针。爸爸陪着他，医生先和玩具猴子乔乔做示范，再温柔地帮他完成检查。故事接纳孩子的担心，也让孩子看见陪伴和勇气；适合看医生前一起共读。

pages.image_alt: 爸爸和博拉坐在诊所长椅上，黄色包里露出红色玩具猴子，墙上贴着身体器官图。
pages.text_zh: 博拉和爸爸坐在诊所里。他的玩具猴子乔乔也来了。乔乔正睡在博拉的包里。
pages.text_original: Bora is sitting at the clinic with Baba. Jojo, his stuffed monkey, came too. Jojo is sleeping in Bora’s bag.

pages.image_alt: 博拉紧紧靠着爸爸，两只手放在身前，爸爸把手搭在他肩上。
pages.text_zh: “我不喜欢打针。打针会疼！”博拉说。
pages.text_original: “I don’t like needles. They hurt!” says Bora.

pages.image_alt: 爸爸蹲下来和博拉面对面说话，博拉坐在长椅上看着他，玩具猴子露在包外。
pages.text_zh: “打针能帮助你保持健康。博拉，害怕也没关系。爸爸会一直陪着你，乔乔也会。”
pages.text_original: “An injection helps make you healthy. It’s okay to be scared, Bora. Baba will be right here with you. And Jojo too.”

pages.image_alt: 医生站在门口叫号，爸爸举起一只手，博拉仍坐在长椅上。
pages.text_zh: “博拉·巴拉卡！”一个响亮的声音叫道。“博拉，走吧。”爸爸说，“轮到你了。”“爸爸，我们明天再来吧！”博拉说。
pages.text_original: “Bora Baraka!” a loud voice calls. “Let’s go Bora,” says Baba. “It’s your turn.” “Let’s come back tomorrow Baba!” says Bora.

pages.image_alt: 博拉站起来，把红色玩具猴子乔乔抱在身边，脸上露出期待的笑容。
pages.text_zh: “还记得爸爸说过，勇敢地打完针后，你会得到什么吗？”爸爸问。“一根红色棒棒糖！好吧，我来啦。”博拉说。
pages.text_original: “Remember what Baba said you will get for being brave enough to get your injection?” asks Baba. “A red lollipop! Okay, I’m coming,” says Bora.

pages.image_alt: 爸爸坐在博拉身后，女医生站在旁边举着红色玩具猴子，博拉抬头看着她。
pages.text_zh: 医生笑着看向博拉。“这是你的小猴子吗？我们也给他检查一下，好吗？”她问。博拉看看爸爸，又看看乔乔，点了点头。
pages.text_original: The doctor smiles at Bora. “Is this your monkey? Can we examine him too?” she asks. Bora looks at Baba, then at Jojo, and nods.

pages.image_alt: 博拉坐在诊室台子上，抱着玩具猴子看向女医生，医生弯身和他说话。
pages.text_zh: “现在轮到你啦。”医生说，“你愿意帮我给你的小猴子打一小针，让他舒服一点吗？”
pages.text_original: “Now, it’s your turn,” she says. “Will you help me give your monkey a small injection so he feels better?” asks the doctor.

pages.image_alt: 医生拿着针筒为红色玩具猴子做示范，博拉在旁边看着。
pages.text_zh: “啵！”医生一边说，一边给玩具猴子乔乔打了一针。
pages.text_original: “TOOP!” says the doctor as she gives Jojo the monkey an injection.

pages.image_alt: 博拉闭着眼睛微笑，医生给他的手臂打针；小图放大了袖口和针筒。
pages.text_zh: “现在轮到你啦。你衣服上的是超级英雄吗？”医生问。“啵！”她一边说，一边给博拉打了针。
pages.text_original: “Now, it’s your turn. Is that a superhero on your T-shirt?” she asks. “TOOP!” she says as she gives Bora the injection.

pages.image_alt: 博拉睁大眼睛，摸着刚打完针的上臂，红色玩具猴子靠在他身旁。
pages.text_zh: “哎哟！”博拉叫了一声，“咦，好像也没那么疼嘛！”
pages.text_original: “Ouch!” shouts Bora. “Hey, that wasn’t so bad!”

pages.image_alt: 女医生拿着夹板微笑，博拉抱着红色玩具猴子坐在旁边。
pages.text_zh: “我知道有一点点刺痛，不过已经打完啦。你刚才很勇敢！”医生说。
pages.text_original: “I know it stings a little, but we’re done and you have been very brave!” says the doctor.

pages.image_alt: 博拉闭着眼睛开心地笑着，一只手拿着红色棒棒糖，一只手牵着玩具猴子，爸爸提着黄色包走在前面。
pages.text_zh: “一根红色棒棒糖，送给勇敢的博拉！”
pages.text_original: “One red lollipop for our brave Bora!”

books.author: Nathalie Koenig
books.description_zh: 小朋友和小猪一起找胡萝卜、玩捉迷藏。一天，小猪不见了；再次相见时，还多了三个小伙伴。暖黄色水彩与简短重复句，适合亲子指图、寻找线索和一起数一数。

pages.image_alt: 小朋友手里拿着胡萝卜，旁边留出一小块草地，远处是暖黄色的树。
pages.text_zh: 小猪，来呀！我们一起玩。你能找到胡萝卜吗？
pages.text_original: Come Pig! Let’s play. Can you find the carrot?

pages.image_alt: 小猪先把头探到石头下面，又去树旁寻找，小朋友站在一边看着。
pages.text_zh: 不在那下面哦。也不在里面呀。
pages.text_original: No, it’s not under there. No, it’s not inside.

pages.image_alt: 小猪掀开草堆的边缘，露出下面的胡萝卜。
pages.text_zh: 小猪，你真聪明！
pages.text_original: Clever Pig!

pages.image_alt: 小朋友跪在木头小屋的门口，向屋里张望，门边没有小猪。
pages.text_zh: 小猪，醒醒啦！出来一起玩吧。她去哪儿了呢？
pages.text_original: Wake up, Pig! Come out and play. Where is she?

pages.image_alt: 小朋友靠在坐着的大人腿边，低着头；地上散着树叶。
pages.text_zh: 小猪不见了。
pages.text_original: Pig is gone.

pages.image_alt: 太阳升起又落下，小朋友独自站在起伏的黄色山坡上。
pages.text_zh: 太阳升起来了。太阳又落下去了。可小猪还是没有回来。
pages.text_original: The sun came up. And the sun went down. But, no Pig.

pages.image_alt: 小朋友独自坐在空盆里，旁边叠着回忆中和小猪一起玩的画面。
pages.text_zh: 我好想我的朋友。
pages.text_original: I miss my friend.

pages.image_alt: 小朋友和回来的大猪面对面，彼此看着对方。
pages.text_zh: 我的小猪！聪明的小猪。
pages.text_original: My Pig! Clever Pig.

pages.image_alt: 三只大小不同的金黄色小猪依次站着。
pages.text_zh: 还有一、二、三个新朋友！
pages.text_original: And one, two, three new friends!

pages.image_alt: 小朋友抱着一只小猪，另外两只坐在盆里，大猪在草堆旁玩耍。
pages.text_zh: 小猪们，来呀！我们一起玩吧。
pages.text_original: Come, pigs! Let’s play.

pages.image_alt: 小朋友向前走，大猪脖子上系着带子跟在旁边，三只小猪排在后面。
pages.text_zh: 该睡觉啦！
pages.text_original: Time for bed!

pages.image_alt: 月亮和星星照着木头小屋，三只金黄色小猪正往小屋的方向走。
pages.text_zh: 小猪们，晚安。
pages.text_original: Goodnight, pigs.

books.author: Nicola Rijsdijk
books.description_zh: 小猫一会儿爬窗帘，一会儿追蝴蝶，午睡时又去了哪里？重复短句和寻找游戏，适合亲子指认、模仿动作与预测。

pages.image_alt: 小猫躲在奶油色沙发下，前面有一只滚动的小球。
pages.text_zh: 小猫，回来呀！和我一起玩吧。
pages.text_original: Come back, cat! Play with me.

pages.image_alt: 小猫坐在铺着软垫的藤篮里，尾巴垂在篮沿。
pages.text_zh: 坐进你的小篮子。乖乖待在这里！
pages.text_original: Sit in your basket. Stay right here!

pages.image_alt: 小猫张开爪子爬上浅蓝色窗帘，离地板很高。
pages.text_zh: 小猫，回来呀！那里太高啦。
pages.text_original: Come back, cat! That’s way too high.

pages.image_alt: 小猫从半开的后门溜出，屋内的篮子留在身后。
pages.text_zh: 小猫，回来呀！别跑到外面去。
pages.text_original: Come back, cat! Don’t go outside.

pages.image_alt: 小猫在花园里追两只蝴蝶，花草围着小径。
pages.text_zh: 瞧，小猫追着蝴蝶跑进了花园。
pages.text_original: Look! Cat is chasing butterflies in the garden.

pages.image_alt: 小猫拉扯晾衣绳上的袜子，线头开始散开。
pages.text_zh: 小猫，回来呀！那可不是你的。
pages.text_original: Come back, cat! That’s not yours.

pages.image_alt: 小猫低头观察蜗牛，袜子的线头缠在尾巴上。
pages.text_zh: 小猫，回来呀！你找到什么啦？
pages.text_original: Come back, cat! What have you got?

pages.image_alt: 小猫带着线头和蜗牛走近母鸡，母鸡张开翅膀。
pages.text_zh: 小猫，回来呀。那不是你的朋友！
pages.text_original: Come back, cat. That’s not your friend!

pages.image_alt: 小猫回到门口，蜗牛在背上，羽毛飘在头边。
pages.text_zh: 你好呀，小猫！你回来了吗？
pages.text_original: Hello, cat! Are you back?

pages.image_alt: 小猫蜷在篮子里，背上还有蜗牛，旁边落着羽毛。
pages.text_zh: 待在篮子里。现在该午睡啦。
pages.text_original: Stay in your basket. It’s nap time now.

pages.image_alt: 篮子里只剩几根羽毛，小猫又不见了。
pages.text_zh: 小猫？
pages.text_original: Cat?

pages.image_alt: 小猫在沙发软垫上闭眼睡觉，蜗牛、线头和羽毛留在旁边。
pages.text_zh: 嘘……小猫在沙发上睡着了。
pages.text_original: Shh... Cat is asleep on the couch.

books.author: Nasrin Siege
books.description_zh: 乌龟奶奶受伤了，小乌龟到兔子朋友家暂住。一起玩耍、入睡，再迎接家人回来，感受朋友的陪伴与关心。

pages.image_alt: 小乌龟在蓝色水里游泳，小兔子坐在岸边的大树下。
pages.text_zh: 小乌龟滕岱住在水里。他最好的朋友是小兔子布西。她住在树上。
pages.text_original: Tendai Turtle lives in the water. Tendai’s best friend is Bunny Busi. She lives in a tree.

pages.image_alt: 乌龟爸爸和妈妈神情担忧，画面中想象着龟壳受伤的奶奶。
pages.text_zh: 乌龟奶奶的壳受伤了。
pages.text_original: Granny Turtle has hurt her shell.

pages.image_alt: 乌龟爸爸妈妈准备出发，树边的小兔子邀请小乌龟来住。
pages.text_zh: “我们得去帮帮奶奶。”妈妈说。“来我家住吧！”布西喊道。
pages.text_original: “We have to go to help Granny,” says Mum. “Come stay with me,” calls Busi.

pages.image_alt: 小兔子站在漂浮的木头上迎接小乌龟，随后两人一起荡秋千。
pages.text_zh: 滕岱住进了布西在树上的家。
pages.text_original: Tendai stays with Bunny Busi in the tree.

pages.image_alt: 小兔子和小乌龟一起仰望飞舞的蝴蝶。
pages.text_zh: 他们玩了一整天。
pages.text_original: They play all day.

pages.image_alt: 小兔子站在小乌龟的壳上摘果子，两个朋友又在树间快乐地玩耍。
pages.text_zh: 两个好朋友在一起，玩得真开心！
pages.text_original: They have so much fun together!

pages.image_alt: 月亮和星星下，小乌龟和小兔子依偎着睡觉。
pages.text_zh: 夜晚，他们一起甜甜地睡着了。
pages.text_original: They sleep all night.

pages.image_alt: 小兔子和小乌龟在岸边迎接游回来的乌龟一家。
pages.text_zh: 爸爸妈妈带着奶奶回来啦。
pages.text_original: Mum and Dad come back with Granny.

pages.image_alt: 小乌龟和小兔子靠近戴着眼镜的奶奶，蝴蝶在旁边飞舞。
pages.text_zh: “奶奶，你好些了吗？”滕岱问。
pages.text_original: “How are you, Granny?” asks Tendai.

pages.image_alt: 奶奶微笑着回答，妈妈指着修补好的龟壳。
pages.text_zh: “我已经好些啦。”奶奶笑着说。“我们把奶奶的壳修好啦。”妈妈回答。
pages.text_original: “I am better now,” says Granny with a smile. “We fixed her shell,” answers Mum.

pages.image_alt: 奶奶拿出一支绿色笛子，小乌龟和小兔子在旁边看着。
pages.text_zh: 奶奶把自己最喜欢的笛子送给了滕岱。
pages.text_original: Granny gives Tendai her favourite flute.

pages.image_alt: 小乌龟吹着笛子，小兔子和乌龟一家在树下跳舞。
pages.text_zh: 滕岱吹起笛子，大家都跳起舞来。
pages.text_original: Tendai plays the flute and everybody dances.

books.author: Tshepo Letsapa
books.description_zh: 菲菲最喜欢的泰迪熊不见了！她找床上、找窗外，最后发现泰迪只是洗了个澡。温暖水彩讲述依恋、担心和重逢。

pages.image_alt: 穿红裙子的菲菲和棕色泰迪熊分别出现在白色画面上。
pages.text_zh: 从还是小宝宝的时候起，菲菲就喜欢泰迪熊了。
pages.text_original: Fifi has loved Teddy since she was a baby.

pages.image_alt: 菲菲抱着泰迪熊坐在餐桌前，又带着它一起荡秋千。
pages.text_zh: 菲菲和泰迪一起吃饭，也和泰迪一起玩。
pages.text_original: Fifi eats with Teddy. Fifi plays with Teddy.

pages.image_alt: 菲菲坐车时抱着泰迪熊，晚上又在床上抱着它睡觉。
pages.text_zh: 不管去哪儿，菲菲都带着泰迪。每天晚上，他们还依偎着一起睡。
pages.text_original: Fifi takes Teddy wherever she goes. And they curl up together every night.

pages.image_alt: 泰迪熊独自坐在菲菲的床上，身后是画着红心的枕头。
pages.text_zh: 菲菲知道，上学不能带泰迪。所以每天早上，她都把泰迪留在床上。
pages.text_original: Fifi knows she cannot take Teddy to school. So every morning she leaves Teddy on her bed.

pages.image_alt: 菲菲从床边探下头，寻找不见了的泰迪熊。
pages.text_zh: 有一天，菲菲放学回家，发现泰迪不见了！
pages.text_original: One day, when she comes back from school, Teddy is not there!

pages.image_alt: 菲菲站在床边掀开蓝色被子，心里想着泰迪熊。
pages.text_zh: 菲菲掀开被子找。泰迪在哪儿呢？
pages.text_original: Fifi looks under the covers. Where is Teddy?

pages.image_alt: 菲菲趴在打开的窗户边向外寻找，心里仍想着泰迪熊。
pages.text_zh: 菲菲又往窗外找。泰迪在哪儿呢？
pages.text_original: Fifi looks outside. Where is Teddy?

pages.image_alt: 菲菲走到正在洗衣服的妈妈身边，妈妈低头看着她。
pages.text_zh: “怎么啦，菲菲？”妈妈问。
pages.text_original: “What’s wrong, Fifi?” asks Mom.

pages.image_alt: 菲菲难过得哭起来，旁边有一大块蓝色的情绪色块。
pages.text_zh: “泰迪不见了！”
pages.text_original: “Teddy is missing!”

pages.image_alt: 妈妈指向晾衣绳，洗过的泰迪熊正挂在那里。
pages.text_zh: “别担心，宝贝。泰迪只是洗了个澡呀！”
pages.text_original: “No, darling. Teddy just had a bath!”

pages.image_alt: 菲菲高兴地举起双手，看着重新找到的泰迪熊。
pages.text_zh: “原来你在这里呀，泰迪！”
pages.text_original: “There you are, Teddy!”

pages.image_alt: 菲菲闭着眼睛拥抱泰迪熊，旁边有两颗温暖的爱心。
pages.text_zh: 菲菲紧紧地抱住了泰迪。
pages.text_original: Fifi gives Teddy a big hug.

books.author: Sam Beckbessinger
books.description_zh: 河马的舞步总打扰邻居，她难过地停了下来，一只小蚱蜢却听见了新的节奏。模仿拟声词，讨论表达自己和照顾别人。

pages.image_alt: 圆润的灰紫色河马在沙地上踏步跳跃，脚边扬起尘土。
pages.text_zh: 河马想跳舞。她在满是尘土的地上跳上跳下。咚！咚！
pages.text_original: Hippo wants to dance. She jumps up and down on the dusty ground. THUMP! THUMP!

pages.image_alt: 马陆在沙地里蜷起身体，河马停下脚步低头看它。
pages.text_zh: “你把我弄脏啦！”睡在沙地里的马陆说，“去别的地方跳吧。”
pages.text_original: “You’re getting dirt on me!” says Shongololo, sleeping in the sand. “Go dance somewhere else.”

pages.image_alt: 河马在河水里翻身跳舞，芦苇旁溅起水花。
pages.text_zh: 河马想跳舞。她滚进河里，手脚一起扑腾。哗啦！哗啦！
pages.text_original: Hippo wants to dance. She rolls into the river and splashes her arms and legs. SPLISH! SPLASH!

pages.image_alt: 翠鸟停在河边枝头抖落水珠，河马露出水面望着它。
pages.text_zh: “你把我弄湿啦！”正在找早餐的翠鸟说，“去别的地方跳吧。”
pages.text_original: “You’re making me wet!” says Kingfisher, hunting for her breakfast. “Go dance somewhere else.”

pages.image_alt: 河马在草地上转圈，一条腿高高抬起。
pages.text_zh: 河马想跳舞。她在草地上转呀转，把腿抬得高高的。呼！呼！
pages.text_original: Hippo wants to dance. She twirls around and around in a field, kicking her legs up high. SWOOSH! SWOOSH!

pages.image_alt: 狐獴守着浴盆里的三只宝宝，河马收回差点踢到它们的腿。
pages.text_zh: “小心！你差点踢到我！”正在给宝宝洗澡的狐獴说，“去别的地方跳吧。”
pages.text_original: “Be careful! You nearly kicked me!” says Meerkat, bathing his babies. “Go dance somewhere else.”

pages.image_alt: 河马趴在泥水洼里用肚皮滑行，泥点飞向四周。
pages.text_zh: 河马想跳舞。她扑进泥水洼，用大肚皮滑来滑去。叽咕！叽咕！
pages.text_original: Hippo wants to dance. She flops into a puddle of mud and slides around on her nice big belly. SQUISH! SQUASH!

pages.image_alt: 驴子背着两只水桶经过，河马从泥洼里抬起头。
pages.text_zh: “你为什么不停下来呢？”驮着水桶的驴子问，“为什么不去做点有用的事呢？”
pages.text_original: “Why don’t you stop dancing?” asks Donkey, carrying his buckets. “Why can’t you do something useful instead?”

pages.image_alt: 河马坐在石头上落泪，小小的绿色蚱蜢站在脚边。
pages.text_zh: 河马很难过，难过得不想跳舞了。她坐在石头上哭，眼泪沿着脸颊流到地上。
pages.text_original: Hippo is sad. She is too sad to dance. She sits on a rock and cries. The tears roll down her cheeks and fall on the ground.

pages.image_alt: 河马的泪滴落地，蚱蜢在两滴眼泪之间跳跃。
pages.text_zh: 蹦！蹦！蚱蜢听见河马的眼泪声，开始绕着她的脚跳舞。啪嗒！啪嗒！
pages.text_original: HOP! HOP! Grasshopper hears Hippo’s tears. He starts dancing around her feet. PLOP! PLOP!

pages.image_alt: 河马和蚱蜢张开手脚一起跳舞，远处动物探头观看。
pages.text_zh: 河马和蚱蜢一起跳起舞来，其他动物都跑来看……
pages.text_original: Hippo and Grasshopper start to dance, and the other animals come to look ...

pages.image_alt: 河马、蚱蜢、马陆、翠鸟、狐獴和驴子在空旷草地上一起跳舞。
pages.text_zh: 大家一起跳起舞来！
pages.text_original: Now everyone is dancing together!

books.author: Candice Dingwall
books.description_zh: 同伴忙着储粮，爱读书的小蚂蚁却有自己的发现。完整的因果故事，适合复述计划如何解决问题，讨论阅读与合作。

pages.image_alt: 戴圆眼镜的小蚂蚁坐在打开的书上，其他蚂蚁背着食物经过。
pages.text_zh: 小蚂蚁爱读书，却常常被同伴取笑：“蚂蚁不读书，蚂蚁要找食。需要的食物，都要自己拾！”
pages.text_original: Little Ant loved to read. Little Ant was often teased. “Ants don’t read. Ants must feed. Ants collect the food they need.”

pages.image_alt: 孩子在野餐毯上读书，小蚂蚁在书边阅读，同伴搬走食物碎屑。
pages.text_zh: 小蚂蚁一整天都在读书，读呀读呀，一天就过去了。其他蚂蚁把找到的食物搬进地下，留着过冬。
pages.text_original: Little Ant would read all day, he’d read and read the day away. The other ants took what they found to store for winter underground.

pages.image_alt: 地下蚁室里，爸爸妈妈站在小蚂蚁面前，小妹妹在一旁看着。
pages.text_zh: 爸爸妈妈很生气，小蚂蚁心里也很难过。
pages.text_original: His mum and dad got really mad, and Little Ant felt really bad.

pages.image_alt: 秋叶铺满地面，蚂蚁们把苹果核和种子搬向地下入口。
pages.text_zh: 秋天，树叶落了下来。蚂蚁们必须把食物储存在地下。
pages.text_original: In autumn when the leaves fall down, the ants must keep food underground.

pages.image_alt: 蚁后站在空空的地下储藏室前，工蚁们围在一旁。
pages.text_zh: 蚁后希望储藏室装满食物，所有蚂蚁都得再多干些活。
pages.text_original: The Queen wants food to fill the store, so all the ants must work some more.

pages.image_alt: 小蚂蚁举起手，想象气泡里出现餐馆、桌子和汉堡。
pages.text_zh: 小蚂蚁大声说起他在书里读到的一个地方：“我们需要找一家餐馆，那是人们吃饭的地方。我读的书里就是这么写的！”
pages.text_original: Little Ant begins to shout about a place he read about. “A restaurant is what we need, a place where people go to feed. It says so in the books I read.”

pages.image_alt: 一队蚂蚁沿小径走向橙色落日，小蚂蚁走在队首。
pages.text_zh: 蚂蚁们一个接着一个出发，朝着落日的方向前进。
pages.text_original: The ants go marching one by one. They march into the setting sun.

pages.image_alt: 小蚂蚁指向有桌椅和餐盘的餐馆入口，同伴停下来张望。
pages.text_zh: 小蚂蚁说：“嘿，那里就有一家！”
pages.text_original: And Little Ant said “Hey, there’s one!”

pages.image_alt: 夜色里，蚂蚁们举着面包和汉堡碎块往蚁穴走。
pages.text_zh: 蚂蚁们一个接着一个往回走，有的搬汉堡，有的搬面包。
pages.text_original: The ants go marching one by one, carrying a burger, carrying a bun.

pages.image_alt: 地下储藏室装满食物，蚁后与戴眼镜的小蚂蚁握手，大家举手欢呼。
pages.text_zh: 回到家，蚁后很高兴。储藏室装满了，大家欢呼起来。
pages.text_original: When they return the Queen is glad. The stores are full. They cheer like mad.

pages.image_alt: 爸爸妈妈从两侧拥抱小蚂蚁，小妹妹在旁边开心地看着。
pages.text_zh: 爸爸妈妈紧紧地拥抱了小蚂蚁。
pages.text_original: Ant gets hugs from mum and dad.

pages.image_alt: 小蚂蚁牵着妹妹坐在打开的书边，两个孩子一起看书。
pages.text_zh: 小妹妹牵住他的手：“现在，我想我明白了。看你那么爱读书，我也想翻开看一看！”
pages.text_original: His baby sister takes his hand “Now I think I understand.” “The way you love to read a book ... Makes me want to take a look.”

books.author: Mirna Lawrence
books.description_zh: 小山羊一路寻找最甜的青草，没发现自己离妈妈越来越远。清淡水彩与重复句式，适合亲子指图、预测与复述。

pages.image_alt: 小山羊走在青草地上，头顶是一片蓝色天空。
pages.text_zh: 小山羊出发去找最甜的青草。头顶的天空蓝蓝的，可她没有抬头看。
pages.text_original: Little Goat went to find the sweetest grass. The sky was blue above. But she did not look up.

pages.image_alt: 小山羊低头在草地上寻找，蓝色的小河就在旁边。
pages.text_zh: 小河在脚边咕噜咕噜地唱歌，可小山羊没有听。
pages.text_original: The river gurgled below. But Little Goat did not listen to its song.

pages.image_alt: 小鸟站在细枝上叫唤，小山羊继续朝前走。
pages.text_zh: 一只小鸟叫住她：“你好呀！”可小山羊没有回答。
pages.text_original: A bird called to her, saying, “How do you do?” But Little Goat didn’t answer.

pages.image_alt: 小山羊在蓝天和绿草间继续向前走。
pages.text_zh: 她只顾一路走，一路找最甜的青草。
pages.text_original: She just walked along looking for the sweetest grass.

pages.image_alt: 山羊妈妈在左边吃草，小山羊独自走向远处。
pages.text_zh: 走着走着，小山羊离妈妈越来越远了。
pages.text_original: As she walked along, Little Goat moved further and further away from Mother Goat.

pages.image_alt: 小山羊大口吃着青草，又低下头继续吃。
pages.text_zh: 小山羊找到了最甜的青草。她吃呀，吃呀。这时，她已经离妈妈很远了。
pages.text_original: Little Goat found the sweetest grass. She ate and ate. She had walked far from Mother Goat.

pages.image_alt: 山羊妈妈先站着张望，再走进高高的玉米地里寻找。
pages.text_zh: 山羊妈妈想：小山羊去哪儿了？她到玉米地里找，可小山羊不在那里。
pages.text_original: Mother Goat wondered where Little Goat had gone. She looked in the mealie patch, but Little Goat was not there.

pages.image_alt: 山羊妈妈跑到小河边，抬起头大声呼唤。
pages.text_zh: 山羊妈妈跑到河边，可小山羊也不在那里。“小山羊，你在哪儿呀？”妈妈咩咩地叫着。
pages.text_original: Mother Goat ran to the river. But Little Goat was not there. “Where are you, Little Goat,” bleated Mother Goat.

pages.image_alt: 小鸟站在枝头，低头告诉抬头张望的山羊妈妈。
pages.text_zh: 一只小鸟告诉山羊妈妈：“小山羊在桥那边，睡在甜甜的青草里呢。”
pages.text_original: A bird called to Mother Goat. “Little Goat is asleep in the sweet grass across the bridge.”

pages.image_alt: 山羊妈妈走过木头小桥，向长着青草的对岸走去。
pages.text_zh: 山羊妈妈走过小桥，来到那片青草地。
pages.text_original: Mother Goat crossed the bridge, to the sweet grass.

pages.image_alt: 小山羊蜷在草地里，闭着眼睛睡觉。
pages.text_zh: 她在那里找到了睡得正香的小山羊。
pages.text_original: There she found Little Goat fast asleep.

pages.image_alt: 山羊妈妈低头轻声叫醒小山羊，小山羊坐在草地上回答。
pages.text_zh: “醒醒，小山羊。”妈妈轻轻地说，“你走丢啦！”“我没有走丢呀……我一直都在这里呢！”小山羊说。
pages.text_original: “Wake up, Little Goat,” said Mother Goat gently. “You were lost!” “I wasn’t lost... I have been here all the time!” said Little Goat.

books.author: Sabina Mutangadura Seldon
books.description_zh: 贾布想玩迪凯托石子游戏，可妈妈、爸爸和哥哥都在忙。他先自己玩起来，慢慢吸引了全家加入。带着纸感的温暖原画，讲述主动尝试、等待和家人相聚。

pages.image_alt: 贾布穿着蓝色上衣站在屋外，一只手托着下巴，草地旁有一只蓝色小生物。
pages.text_zh: 贾布一心只想玩。他可以玩什么呢？
pages.text_original: All Jabu wants to do is play. What can he do?

pages.image_alt: 贾布笑着张开双臂，许多小石子在空中散开，蓝色小生物站在一边。
pages.text_zh: 玩迪凯托石子游戏！可是，谁能和他一起玩呢？
pages.text_original: Diketo! But who can play with him?

pages.image_alt: 贾布站在房子外面，向窗里的妈妈发出邀请；妈妈在冒着热气的锅边忙碌。
pages.text_zh: “妈妈，来和我一起玩吧。”可是妈妈正在做玉米糊和菠菜。
pages.text_original: “Mama, come and play with me.” But Mama is cooking pap and spinach.

pages.image_alt: 爸爸握着铲子挖土，泥土扬到空中，贾布站在旁边看着他。
pages.text_zh: “爸爸，来和我一起玩吧。”可是爸爸正忙着挖一个大坑。
pages.text_original: “Baba, come and play with me.” But Baba is busy digging a big hole.

pages.image_alt: 贾布从门帘旁探进头，哥哥兹韦坐在房间里，捧着一本黄色的书。
pages.text_zh: “兹韦，来和我一起玩吧。”可是哥哥正忙着看书。
pages.text_original: “Zwe, come and play with me.” But his brother is busy reading.

pages.image_alt: 贾布坐在屋外的地上，低着头看向地面，旁边的蓝色小生物也垂着手。
pages.text_zh: 贾布坐在外面。他好想玩迪凯托呀！可是，没有人和他一起玩。
pages.text_original: Jabu sits outside. He wants to play diketo! But there is no one to play with.

pages.image_alt: 贾布的手伸向地上的小坑，坑里放着小石子，蓝色小生物在坑边张开双手。
pages.text_zh: 那就先自己玩吧。一个人玩也不错！他在地上挖了一个小坑，然后把十颗小石子放进去。
pages.text_original: So he plays alone. It’s not so bad! He digs a small hole in the earth. Then he puts ten small stones inside the hole.

pages.image_alt: 贾布开心地笑着，手臂举向空中，爸爸在一边停下铲子看着他。
pages.text_zh: 真好玩！爸爸看到了贾布，停下了挖大坑的活儿。
pages.text_original: So much fun! Dad sees Jabu and stops digging his big hole.

pages.image_alt: 妈妈端着一盘食物走出屋子，贾布和爸爸坐在地上玩，脸上带着笑容。
pages.text_zh: 妈妈也出来了，端着玉米糊和菠菜。
pages.text_original: Mama comes out with some pap and spinach.

pages.image_alt: 兹韦从窗边向外张望，窗外的爸爸、妈妈和贾布聚在一起，妈妈手里端着食物。
pages.text_zh: 兹韦向窗外看，看见大家都在一起。他可不想错过这些好玩的事，于是也去加入他们。
pages.text_original: Zwe looks out the window and sees everyone. He doesn’t want to miss out on all the fun. So he goes to join them.

pages.image_alt: 贾布、哥哥、爸爸和妈妈挨在一起，都闭着眼睛露出笑容。
pages.text_zh: 贾布和家人靠在一起，笑得开开心心。
pages.text_original: Jabu and his family smile together.

pages.image_alt: 一家人的手围着地上的石子和小坑伸过来，妈妈手腕上戴着彩色手镯，蓝色小生物也举着双手。
pages.text_zh: 终于，有人陪贾布一起玩啦。
pages.text_original: At last, Jabu has people to play with.

books.author: Paul Kennedy
books.description_zh: 树懒先生一心想睡觉，可树枝旁总有新邻居。跟随重复问句猜下一位动物，观察局部线索，直到找到适合休息的地方。

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生站在大树下张嘴打哈欠，两只手揉眼睛。
pages.text_zh: 一天，树懒先生来做客。他说：“我好困！我需要一根好树枝，当作我的床！”
pages.text_original: One day, Mr Sloth came to visit. He said: I’m sleepy! I need a good branch for a bed!

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生用长长的手臂攀上树干，在两根树枝间荡起身子。
pages.text_zh: “我很会爬树，也知道怎么荡秋千。不过，睡觉才是我最最喜欢的事！”
pages.text_original: I’m quite good at climbing. I know how to swing. But sleeping’s my favourite, favourite thing!

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生靠近低处的一根枝条，树叶后露出长颈鹿的耳朵。
pages.text_zh: “这根树枝真不错！我想睡在这里。你呢？你觉得这个主意好不好？”
pages.text_original: This branch looks lovely! I think I’ll sleep here. And you? Don’t you think that’s a splendid idea?

pages.image_alt: 长颈鹿伸长脖子吃叶子，树懒先生赶紧挪开，躲开它的嘴。
pages.text_zh: 哎呀，树懒先生！长颈鹿正在这里吃东西呢！它可能以为你是午餐，咬到你的毛！
pages.text_original: Oh no, Mr Sloth! A giraffe’s eating there! He might think you’re lunch and start nibbling your hair!

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生来到另一根树枝，树梢藏着蜂窝，几只蜜蜂飞近。
pages.text_zh: “这根树枝真不错！我想睡在这里。你呢？你觉得这个主意好不好？”
pages.text_original: This branch looks lovely! I think I’ll sleep here. And you? Don’t you think that’s a splendid idea?

pages.image_alt: 蜜蜂从蜂窝飞出围着枝条，树懒先生抬起手臂避让。
pages.text_zh: 哎呀，树懒先生！旁边就是蜂窝！蜜蜂飞来飞去，你可没法好好睡觉！
pages.text_original: Oh no, Mr Sloth! There’s a beehive right there! You’ll never get sleep with those bees everywhere!

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生伸手去抓一根弯弯的绿色形状，末端露出蛇尾。
pages.text_zh: “这根树枝真不错！我想睡在这里。你呢？你觉得这个主意好不好？”
pages.text_original: This branch looks lovely! I think I’ll sleep here. And you? Don’t you think that’s a splendid idea?

pages.image_alt: 小蛇睁大眼睛弯起身子，树懒先生松开手。
pages.text_zh: 哎呀，树懒先生！那是一条蛇，不是树枝！可怜的蛇，被你吓了一大跳。
pages.text_original: Oh no, Mr Sloth, that’s a snake over there! Not a branch! Poor old snake. You gave him quite a scare.

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生靠近更高的枝条，茂密叶子后露出两只鸟脚。
pages.text_zh: “这根树枝真不错！我想睡在这里。你呢？你觉得这个主意好不好？”
pages.text_original: This branch looks lovely! I think I’ll sleep here. And you? Don’t you think that’s a splendid idea?

pages.image_alt: 一只长嘴鸟张嘴鸣叫，树懒先生捂住耳朵。
pages.text_zh: 哎呀，树懒先生！这里有只大声叫的鸟！这么吵，你可睡不着！
pages.text_original: Oh no, Mr Sloth! There’s a bird squawking there! You’ll never get sleep with that noise in the air!

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生爬到最高处的宽树枝上，满意地笑起来。
pages.text_zh: “再往上爬一根树枝，树懒先生！”大家说。那根树枝，正好可以当他的床。
pages.text_original: Try climb one more branch, Mr Sloth! they all said. And that branch was just the right one for his bed.

pages.image_alt: 树懒先生在高枝上闭眼睡觉，鸟和蛇安静休息，长颈鹿和蜜蜂各在树的一侧。
pages.text_zh: 鸟儿、小蛇、长颈鹿，还有每一只蜜蜂，都很高兴和树懒先生住在同一棵树上。
pages.text_original: The bird and the snake, the giraffe and each bee were happy to have Mr Sloth in their tree.

books.author: Maya Fowler
books.description_zh: 陆龟一路寻找自己的家，背上的朋友越来越多，天气也越来越糟。通过重复叙事、角色累加与结尾反转，练习观察和预测。

pages.image_alt: 陆龟低头寻找，草叶旁的蜗牛抬起触角问话。
pages.text_zh: 一天，陆龟走在草原上。他找了又找，望望远处，又眯起眼睛看草丛。“你在找什么吗？”蜗牛问。“是呀，我在找我的家。你看见了吗？”
pages.text_original: One day Tortoise was walking through the veld. He was searching and searching. He gazed into the distance and squinted at the grass. “Are you looking for something?” Snail asked. “Yes, I’m looking for my house. Have you seen it?”

pages.image_alt: 蜗牛坐在陆龟背上，两位朋友沿着草原小路前进。
pages.text_zh: “没有，不过我来帮你找！”蜗牛爬上陆龟的壳。陆龟背着她继续走。他们找呀找，可哪里都没有房子的影子。
pages.text_original: “No, I haven’t, but I’ll help you look!” She climbed onto Tortoise’s shell. Tortoise walked on with Snail on his back. They looked and looked, but there was no sign of a house.

pages.image_alt: 麻雀停在低树枝上，陆龟和背上的蜗牛抬头看它。
pages.text_zh: “你们在找什么吗？”麻雀问。“是呀，我们在找陆龟的家。你看见了吗？”“没有，不过我来帮你们找！”
pages.text_original: “Are you looking for something?” asked Sparrow. “Yes, we're looking for Tortoise's house. Have you seen it?” “No, I haven’t, but I’ll help you look!”

pages.image_alt: 麻雀先飞到前方，又转身落向陆龟的壳。
pages.text_zh: 麻雀扑扇翅膀，嗖地飞了出去。“你太快啦！”陆龟喊。“好吧，那我也坐上来。”陆龟背着蜗牛和麻雀继续走。他们找呀找，可哪里都没有房子的影子。
pages.text_original: Sparrow flapped his wings and he whizzed away. “You’re going too fast!” called Tortoise. “Alright, then I’ll hop on too.” Tortoise walked on with Snail and Sparrow perched on his shell. They looked and looked, but there was no sign of a house.

pages.image_alt: 瓢虫站在蒲公英上，陆龟背着蜗牛和麻雀经过。
pages.text_zh: “你们在找什么吗？”瓢虫问。“是呀，我们在找陆龟的家。你看见了吗？”
pages.text_original: “Are you looking for something?” asked Ladybird. “Yes, we’re looking for Tortoise’s house. Have you seen it?”

pages.image_alt: 瓢虫加入龟背上的伙伴，微风吹动小草。
pages.text_zh: “没有，不过我来帮你们找！”瓢虫跳到陆龟壳上。陆龟背着蜗牛、麻雀和瓢虫继续走。他们找呀找，可哪里都没有房子的影子。微风吹了起来。
pages.text_original: “No, I haven’t, but I’ll help you look!” Ladybird hopped onto Tortoise’s shell. Tortoise walked on with Snail and Sparrow and Ladybird sitting on his back. They looked and looked, but there was no sign of a house. A breeze started to blow.

pages.image_alt: 老鼠坐在花边编花环，陆龟和背上的三位朋友停下来。
pages.text_zh: “你们在找什么吗？”老鼠问。“是呀，老鼠，我在找我的家。你看见了吗？”“没有，不过我来帮你们找！”
pages.text_original: “Are you looking for something?” asked Mouse. “Yes, Mouse, I’m looking for my house. Have you seen it?” “No, I haven’t, but I’ll help you look!”

pages.image_alt: 老鼠也爬上龟背，四位朋友挤在一起，落叶随风旋转。
pages.text_zh: 老鼠跳上陆龟的背。陆龟背着蜗牛、麻雀、瓢虫和老鼠继续走。他们找呀找，可哪里都没有房子的影子。风卷起地上的叶子，在陆龟身边打转。
pages.text_original: Mouse jumped onto Tortoise’s back. Tortoise walked on with Snail and Sparrow and Ladybird and Mouse on his back. They looked and looked, but there was no sign of a house. The wind swept the leaves off the ground and swirled them around Tortoise.

pages.image_alt: 乌云和闪电出现在远山，陆龟背着四位朋友走在雨里。
pages.text_zh: 风越来越大，天空暗了下来。“唉，我的家到底在哪里？”陆龟叹气。远处的山里雷声轰隆，电光闪过。滴答，滴答，下雨了。“陆龟的家到底在哪里？”蜗牛、麻雀、瓢虫和老鼠一起问。
pages.text_original: The wind got stronger and stronger. The sky turned dark. “Oh, where is my house?” Tortoise sighed. Thunder roared in the hills. Lightning flashed in the distance. Drip, drip came the rain. “Oh, where is Tortoise’s house?” asked Snail and Sparrow and Ladybird and Mouse.

pages.image_alt: 大风把四位伙伴从龟背吹向两旁，叶片在空中翻滚。
pages.text_zh: 风呼呼地卷着、吹着，把蜗牛、麻雀、瓢虫和老鼠全都从陆龟的背上吹了下来。
pages.text_original: The wind whirled and whipped and blew Snail and Sparrow and Ladybird and Mouse right off Tortoise’s back.

pages.image_alt: 陆龟的头脚缩进壳里，雨滴落在完整的壳上，四位朋友站在旁边。
pages.text_zh: “呀！”陆龟吓得叫了一声，缩进自己的壳里。里面温暖又舒适。“哦，原来我的家就在这里！”
pages.text_original: “Eek!” squeaked Tortoise with a fright, and he shrank back into his shell. It was warm and cosy inside. “Oh, here is my house!”

pages.image_alt: 蜗牛、麻雀、瓢虫和老鼠在陆龟壳的边缘下躲雨，壳里透出暖光。
pages.text_zh: “哦，原来陆龟的家就在这里！”
pages.text_original: “Oh, here is Tortoise’s house!”

books.author: Kate Sidley
books.description_zh: 没有长鼻子，没有尾巴，也没有羽毛，那团影子究竟是什么？想象动物们的猜测变成了误会，结尾发现彼此都是宝宝。适合比较特征、分辨猜测与事实。

pages.image_alt: 几只想象中的小动物聚在草地上，看着远处一团灰色影子。
pages.text_zh: 那是什么呀？
pages.text_original: What is it?

pages.image_alt: 长鼻子、鳄鱼尾巴的想象动物指着灰影，展示自己的长鼻子。
pages.text_zh: 那是什么呀？它没有长鼻子，和我不一样。
pages.text_original: What is it? It hasn't got a trunk. It's not like me.

pages.image_alt: 长尾巴的猴鼠模样动物转身展示尾巴，望向没有尾巴的灰影。
pages.text_zh: 那是什么呀？它没有尾巴，和我不一样。
pages.text_original: What is it? It hasn’t got a tail. It’s not like me.

pages.image_alt: 披着绒毛和羽毛的猫头鹰模样动物张开翅膀，望向灰影。
pages.text_zh: 那是什么呀？咦！它的羽毛呢？它和我不一样。
pages.text_original: What is it? Ugh! Where are its feathers? It’s not like me.

pages.image_alt: 长着小爪子的羚羊妈妈和宝宝并排站着，望向影子的小脚。
pages.text_zh: 那是什么呀？瞧它那两只小脚，和我们不一样。
pages.text_original: What is it? Look at those tiny feet. It’s not like us.

pages.image_alt: 长鼻子的动物躲在树后探头，灰影仍在远处。
pages.text_zh: 你们觉得，它危险吗？
pages.text_original: Do you think it’s dangerous?

pages.image_alt: 长尾巴动物靠近伙伴，小声猜测灰影的来历。
pages.text_zh: 你们觉得，它会吃掉我们吗？
pages.text_original: Do you think it wants to eat us?

pages.image_alt: 灰影前出现一个打喷嚏的人类宝宝，头边有两道小气流。
pages.text_zh: 阿嚏！阿嚏！
pages.text_original: Achoo! Achoo!

pages.image_alt: 想象动物们睁大眼睛转身逃跑，草叶被脚步带起。
pages.text_zh: 啊！呀！快跑！
pages.text_original: Aargh! Eek! Run!

pages.image_alt: 人类宝宝在阳光下爬行，身后拖着灰色影子，动物们回头张望。
pages.text_zh: 它追上来啦！
pages.text_original: It's chasing us!

pages.image_alt: 羚羊宝宝停下来朝人类宝宝走去，妈妈在后方招呼。
pages.text_zh: 小心呀，回来！
pages.text_original: Be careful. Come back.

pages.image_alt: 羚羊宝宝和人类宝宝碰了碰鼻尖，伙伴们从后面探头微笑。
pages.text_zh: 它是什么呀？原来是个宝宝，和我一样！
pages.text_original: What is it? It's a baby, just like me!

books.author: Griffin Shea
books.description_zh: 心爱的帽子不见了，小獴一路问朋友：你吃了我的帽子吗？从生气、道歉到一起做新帽子，重复问答里藏着体谅与合作。0–2岁适合亲子指图，3–4岁可以聊聊怎样解决小冲突。

pages.image_alt: 小獴坐在石头上，心形图案里是一顶插着花的帽子。
pages.text_zh: 我好喜欢我的帽子。
pages.text_original: I love my hat.

pages.image_alt: 小獴睁大眼睛、张开嘴，发现帽子不见了。
pages.text_zh: 我的帽子刚才还在这儿呢。谁吃了我的帽子？
pages.text_original: My hat was here. Who ate my hat?

pages.image_alt: 小獴向一只棕色小动物提问，对方正笑着嚼胡萝卜。
pages.text_zh: 你吃了我的帽子吗？我不吃帽子。我喜欢咔嚓咔嚓地嚼胡萝卜。
pages.text_original: Did you eat my hat? I don’t eat hats. I crunch on carrots.

pages.image_alt: 小獴摊开双手，长着红色鬃毛的狮子正在吃坚果。
pages.text_zh: 你吃了我的帽子吗？我不吃帽子。我喜欢一点一点地啃坚果。
pages.text_original: Did you eat my hat? I don’t eat hats. I nibble on nuts.

pages.image_alt: 小獴问一只猴子，猴子捧着芒果吃得很开心。
pages.text_zh: 你吃了我的帽子吗？我不吃帽子。我喜欢大口大口地吃芒果。
pages.text_original: Did you eat my hat? I don’t eat hats. I munch on mangoes.

pages.image_alt: 小獴看着正在吃花的斑马，花丛中露出一截黑色帽带。
pages.text_zh: 你吃了我的帽子吗？我不吃帽子。我最爱大口吃鲜花。
pages.text_original: Did you eat my hat? I don’t eat hats. I feast on flowers.

pages.image_alt: 小獴转向斑马，瞪大眼睛，嘴巴张得大大的。
pages.text_zh: 那是我的帽子！你把我的帽子吃掉啦。
pages.text_original: That’s my hat! You ate my hat.

pages.image_alt: 小獴和斑马面对面，两双大眼睛看着对方。
pages.text_zh: 斑马和小獴看着彼此，一时都没说话。
pages.text_original: Zebra and Meerkat look at each other.

pages.image_alt: 斑马低下眼睛，神情带着歉意，嘴角微微扬起。
pages.text_zh: 对不起。我们可以一起做一顶新帽子。
pages.text_original: I’m sorry. We can make a new hat.

pages.image_alt: 小獴和斑马的手把花朵装饰到蓝色帽子上。
pages.text_zh: 他们一起动手，做好了新帽子。
pages.text_original: They make new hats together.

pages.image_alt: 斑马和小獴都戴上插着花的蓝色帽子，笑着看向彼此。
pages.text_zh: 我好喜欢我的新帽子。我也好喜欢我的新帽子。
pages.text_original: I love my new hat. I love my new hat too.

pages.image_alt: 戴帽子的小獴和斑马吃着三明治，狮子和猴子坐在身后，棕色小动物挥着手跑过来。
pages.text_zh: 现在，朋友们坐在一起，开开心心地野餐。
pages.text_original: Now the friends share a picnic.

books.author: Paul Kennedy
books.description_zh: 小机器人捡到一颗纽扣，穿过热闹街道寻找主人，最终收获新朋友。适合讨论助人、换位思考和等车通行；信号灯情节是角色的误会。

pages.image_alt: 蓝绿色小机器人丁丁坐在路沿，一颗四孔蓝纽扣滚到面前。
pages.text_zh: 小机器人丁丁坐在路边，一颗纽扣蹦蹦跳跳地滚到了他面前。
pages.text_original: Tinny Tim was sitting on the road when a button bounced his way.

pages.image_alt: 丁丁双手捧着纽扣，沿着人行道向前寻找。
pages.text_zh: “这会是从哪里掉下来的呢？”他说。他想弄个明白。
pages.text_original: “I wonder where this comes from,” he said. He wanted to find out.

pages.image_alt: 一只巨大的红鞋落在人行道上，丁丁抱着纽扣站在鞋边。
pages.text_zh: 路边人来人往。“哇！”他差点被一只大鞋子踩扁。
pages.text_original: It was busy on the side of the road. “Woah!” He nearly got squashed.

pages.image_alt: 丁丁抓着红鞋的鞋带荡开，纽扣抱在胸前。
pages.text_zh: 他幸运地逃开了。“外面真有点吓人。”他说。
pages.text_original: He made a lucky escape. “It’s scary out here,” he said.

pages.image_alt: 丁丁举起纽扣，抬头看行人信号灯上的绿色小人。
pages.text_zh: “你好呀，这是你的吗？”
pages.text_original: “Hey there, is this yours?”

pages.image_alt: 同一盏行人信号灯变成红色，丁丁仍举着蓝纽扣。
pages.text_zh: 绿衣人什么也没说，只是变成了红色。“真不礼貌。”
pages.text_original: The green man said nothing. He just turned red. “What a rude person.”

pages.image_alt: 丁丁沿街寻找，一只棕色小狗从前面走来。
pages.text_zh: 丁丁继续寻找。“这是谁的纽扣呢？”
pages.text_original: Tinny Tim carried on looking. “Whose button is this?”

pages.image_alt: 小狗低头舔丁丁，丁丁抱着纽扣，脸上沾着水珠。
pages.text_zh: “哇……至少，它还挺友好的。”
pages.text_original: “Woah..! ...at least he’s friendly.”

pages.image_alt: 丁丁停在人行横道的路沿内侧，望向街对面。
pages.text_zh: “我得去马路对面。我想，纽扣一定是从那里掉过来的。”
pages.text_original: “I’ve got to get to the other side. I’m sure that’s where this comes from.”

pages.image_alt: 汽车驶过水洼溅起水花，丁丁留在人行道上等待。
pages.text_zh: 哗啦！“好险呀。”他等车子都开过去，才继续往前走。
pages.text_original: SPLASH! “That was close.” He waited for the cars to pass before he carried on.

pages.image_alt: 丁丁举着纽扣，向街边一个坐在长椅上的布娃娃打招呼。
pages.text_zh: 也许，这就是他要找的人。“你好，你是谁呀？”
pages.text_original: Maybe this was who he was looking for. “Hello, who are you?”

pages.image_alt: 布娃娃露比一只眼睛是蓝纽扣，另一只眼睛处只有针脚；丁丁递出纽扣。
pages.text_zh: “我是布娃娃露比。”“我想，这是你的。”丁丁说。
pages.text_original: “I’m Ruby Rags.” “I think this is yours,”he said.

pages.image_alt: 露比的两只纽扣眼睛都完整了，和丁丁并肩坐在长椅上。
pages.text_zh: “谢谢你，小机器人。我们可以做朋友吗？”
pages.text_original: “Thank you, little robot. Can we be friends?”
